integrity: The proof reconstructs adjacency from the Frattini quotient and the fact that conjugation is trivial modulo the Frattini subgroup. The packaged replay independently computes subgroup lattices, Frattini subgroups, conjugacy classes, and all invariable-generating adjacencies for four examples.
scientific_limitations: The group is finite, noncyclic, and two-generated, with prime-power order.
The theorem fixes the multipartite structure but not the individual part sizes from p alone.
The proof is elementary once Burnside's basis theorem and the nilpotent invariable-generation observation are combined.
An equivalent formulation could exist under ordinary generating-graph or Frattini-quotient terminology.
title: The invariably generating graph of a two-generated finite \(p\)-group
